Description: Path Tile Cost (Round 89) — per-waypoint terrain tags for enemy navigation paths. Each waypoint index 0..N has a terrain tag (0=neutral, 1=Slow -25% speed, 2=Boost +25% speed, 3=Snow +15% damage taken, 4=Heal reserved, 5=Wall stop). Defaults are all 0 (neutral) so the system has zero behavioral impact unless a level/game config populates non-zero tags. To opt in for a level, set the relevant node indices to non-zero values from the game config loader.

TagReference.4: Heal (reserved for future per-frame HP regen)
